findings.description: F-002: the comparison table claimed smooth=True 'убирает часть угловатости на резких поворотах'. The pencil creates one 2-point create_line per drag event; a 2-point line has no interior vertex to smooth, and the 'sharp turns' are joins between separate Canvas items that smooth cannot affect. Proven: postscript identical with smooth True/False at 2 points, different at 3. paint_app.py carried the same dead option twice.
findings.resolution: Fixed in two places. scripts/build_chapter_18.py (build_14): removed smooth=True from the karandash.py snippet, replaced the false table row with a truthful `width` row, and replaced the hedging callout with 'А как же smooth=True? Здесь он не сработает', which states that Tk smooths only INTERNAL points of one line and each segment has exactly two. projects/tkinter/paint-app/paint_app.py: removed smooth=True from both create_line calls (on_drag and _draw_shape) with an explanatory comment. Verified: grep -c 'smooth=' paint_app.py -> 0; 'убирает часть угловатости' -> 0 hits in HTML.

findings.description: F-008: the third bullet against the naive approach ('на длинный штрих уходит гораздо больше элементов Canvas, чем нужно') was not addressed by the proposed fix. Measured: 6 motion events give 6 ovals naively and 6 line segments with the fix -- identical. Only a single accumulating polyline via coords() gives 1 item.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_18.py (build_14): the bullet was replaced with one the fix genuinely does address ('кружок ничего не знает о том, где курсор был мгновение назад — путь между двумя соседними событиями просто теряется'). The element-count argument now appears only in the new 'Куда это можно развить' callout, where it is true. Verified: 'гораздо больше элементов' -> 0 hits.

findings.description: F-021: first section to use `self.` / `self.state` / `self.canvas`, but class PaintApp is not introduced until 18.29.
findings.resolution: Fixed in scripts/build_chapter_18.py (build_14): added an info callout 'Отсюда код — это методы класса PaintApp' telling the reader the methods belong to PaintApp, that it is assembled in 18.29, and how to read self.state.color meanwhile. Verified PRESENT in regenerated HTML.
